error_categories.description: The trace relies on unsupported media-grounded claims about what was said at 4:24 ('the man said he will do it') without any tool-attributed transcript or other text-provided evidence. In text-only mode, this audio/timestamp claim is not justified.

Even if someone 'said he will do it,' the jump to 'The person in black' is unsupported: the trace provides no text-grounded basis identifying that speaker as the person in black or establishing that 'sending the body' answers the question 'who wants to send the body into the water slide.'

summary: The trace reaches a clear final answer, but it is not justified from text alone because it depends on unsupported claims about a timestamped spoken statement and an ungrounded identification of that speaker as the person in black.
